reviews.text: We requested a 3-night, 4-day stay. We dropped off our dog early in the morning and picked him up late at night, but we are very grateful for your flexible response. Being able to check on him anytime via camera gave us great peace of mind. Seeing our dog relaxing near the trainer made us feel that we made the right choice. Thank you for the advice you gave us about our dog's legs and for your very kind service. We would definitely like to use your services again when we travel in the future.

I consulted with you about walks and how to maintain distance from other dogs, and I was very relieved to receive clear and easy-to-understand advice! I'm also really grateful for the follow-up support via LINE and other means. I will continue to work hard on training at my dog's pace!

I was very worried because it was my dog's first time staying overnight, and for such a long period of 7 nights and 8 days, but I was relieved to always see him looking well through the camera. Seeing him happily wagging his tail at the trainer through the camera made me so glad I left him with you.

We also received advice on feeding and training, and when he came back, he was barking and biting much less than before.

Thank you so much. I would definitely like to ask for your services again next time my dog ​​needs an overnight stay.

We stayed for 2 nights and 3 days.

My dog ​​is a little shy around other dogs, so I was honestly a bit worried before leaving him there. However, the care taken with the fences was excellent, and I felt very at ease leaving him in their care.

Despite that, I was surprised to see him walking with the owner's dog during his stay. I was so happy, thinking, "He's supposed to be shy, but he was able to do this!"

Previously, when we left him at a different place, he suffered from severe diarrhea and vomiting due to stress, but this time he was in good spirits when we picked him up.

It was also very helpful that we could check on him at any time during the day using the camera.

He had become very attached to the owner, and we could even see him asking for petting on the camera.

Being able to check on him even when we were apart gave us peace of mind during our trip.

I am truly grateful to have found a place where I can leave my beloved dog with peace of mind. Thank you so much to the owner for being so kind!

If I have the opportunity again, I would definitely like to use your services again.

I left my toy poodle in your care for three days and two nights. The TAPO camera allowed me to check on him from my travel destination, and the report I received during his stay gave me peace of mind. I would definitely like to use your services again next time. Thank you very much! I've also recommended you to a fellow dog walker near my home.
They even took my dog ​​for a walk, and it seems my dog ​​had a great time.

We had our 4-month-old Miniature Dachshund puppy trained!

Even though it was the first session, the instructor taught us very thoroughly, and we are very satisfied 😊
We didn't know how to prepare the puppy's environment, and we were confused about how to deal with problems that arose.

After the training, it seems like a happy life with our dog has begun, and we are very happy about that.

I compared various options and chose this service because it had good reviews and I felt confident using a trainer.

It was my first time leaving my dog ​​with someone other than family, and I was worried, but being able to check on him via camera the whole time was great.

They even took him for walks and told me how many times he had to relieve himself during his stay!

I also received professional advice. ☺︎

I look forward to using their services again in the future.

I was really convinced by the advice, which went beyond just superficial techniques and explained the dog's feelings and the principles behind their behavior. When I followed their advice, my dog ​​seemed happy, and that made me happy too! ☺️ It's so reassuring to have a teacher I can always rely on!

I'll do my best to ensure that both dogs and humans can live happily together as a pack!

We recently welcomed a 4-month-old mixed-breed small dog (male) into our home.
We were worried about his crying when left alone and whether our living situation (including how we were using his cage) was okay, when we found out about this training class.
We were eager to learn as soon as possible, so we tentatively requested a reservation for the next day, and they kindly accommodated our request, saying it would be better to act quickly.
They explained the basics of dog care, areas for improvement in our lifestyle, and training methods in an easy-to-understand way, even for a beginner like me.
They also empathized with our anxieties and worries, which lightened our spirits.
Our puppy was initially wary and cried, but he became more cooperative during training, and we were impressed by the trainer's skill.
They also told us we could contact them anytime via LINE, and they actually provided advice, which was incredibly reassuring.
We are so glad we chose this trainer.

This was our first time requesting a 2-night, 3-day stay.

A pet camera was installed, allowing us to monitor our pet 24 hours a day.

When we went to pick up our pet, we were able to hear about how it had been, which gave us peace of mind.

We look forward to using your services again next time.

Thank you very much.

I was hesitant to leave my rescue dog with anyone, but I suddenly needed to leave him for an extended period, so I found this place on their website.
I was able to leave him with peace of mind because I could check on his condition using the monitoring camera.
Also, when I picked him up, I received a report detailing things like his walking time and appetite, which was very helpful as I could check on his health while he was in their care.

I recently used your service for a 1-night, 2-day stay.

Although my dog ​​was dropped off early, the staff handled everything very carefully, which was a great help.

I was a little worried about my dog ​​being with other dogs for about two hours, but the partitions and other measures were in place, which put my mind at ease.

Upon pickup, I received a report on my dog's day and some advice, making it a very satisfying 1-night, 2-day stay.

The ability to check on my dog ​​via camera was innovative and wonderful.

I would definitely like to use your service again!

Thank you very much!

This was my first dog's first overnight stay.
The owner and family were very helpful and willing to answer any questions I had, and they really took good care of him while he was in the care.
They also gave me advice on how to interact with dogs and training, which was very educational.
I also felt reassured that I could keep an eye on him via phone throughout the time he was in the care.
Thank you for taking him for walks morning and evening.
I'm grateful that you were flexible enough to accommodate the dog's type, and that you even gave me a sheet of paper with a description of his day's activities when I left.
I'd definitely like to use your services again if the opportunity arises ^_^
Thank you!

This is the first time I've ever had a dog, and while I was looking at YouTube videos and other resources, I just couldn't get it to work, so I decided to consult with you. (This is my third training session.)
The things I was struggling with have improved significantly, and I'm enjoying more time with my dog.

After actually asking for advice, I found that YouTube videos often have a lot of unnecessary advertising intros and preambles, which makes them take a long time to watch, and often miss important details.
Since what's said on YouTube varies slightly depending on the video, I wanted to trust this person and consult with them directly, and it was a great decision.

Not only did they help with specific training topics, but they also made suggestions about the overall care and living environment, which has made our time more enjoyable than ever.

I'm still in the middle of training, so I hope to level up and continue consulting with them to improve my living environment and enjoy life.

Even after just one training session, they were always available to answer any questions I might have, and they were very helpful in answering my questions via LINE. (^_^)

I used your dog homestay (dog hotel) service. I can only say that I'm so glad I chose you. Being able to check on my dog ​​via pet camera gave me peace of mind and made me happy. I was worried that my dog ​​might not eat at all at a new place because he's a picky eater at home, but I was surprised that he ate everything at all three meal times. Even after returning home, he continues to eat everything with just a little softened food and toppings. You provided not only verbal information but also written reports on his potty breaks and walks, which allowed me to share updates with my family after returning home. He seemed wary during the initial consultation, but it was clear that you didn't force anything and adjusted to my dog's pace. I was so happy to see him approaching you on his own via pet camera. I often take my dog ​​with me on trips, but as he gets older, even if we can take him to places, considering the temperature and his physical condition, having someone to leave him with is incredibly reassuring.

I would like to use your services again if the opportunity arises, so I hope we can continue our relationship for a long time. Thank you so much for everything!

I've used their initial training and homestay services several times.
I have no experience owning a dog myself and was completely clueless, but I'm so glad I chose them.
They patiently answered all my questions, provided thorough reports on my dog's well-being during homestays, and the monitoring camera gave me peace of mind.
I think they are a very trustworthy trainer 😊
I would like to continue using their services for walk training and homestays whenever I need to leave my dog ​​with them.

I asked many questions, and they answered them very carefully. I also found it appealing that I could easily consult with them via LINE if I had any questions. I look forward to continuing to work with you in the future.

After bringing home our second dog, there were constant fights between him and our older dog, and even after the puppy had finished all his vaccinations, we were worried because we couldn't let him out of his cage.

After searching extensively, we chose this company because of the excellent reviews.

After the second training session, we were so moved when we let them out of their cages for the first time and they were able to stay calm in the same space.

Now, even if they fight (roughly), they calm down after repeating the training and cool-down exercises we were taught, and they can sleep together in the same space.

We are truly grateful for the careful advice we received regarding their food and weight.

Both dogs look forward to seeing the trainer every time, and now we feel confident entrusting them to the trainer for an overnight stay if anything happens.

Thank you so much for your continued support.

This was Hota's first time leaving her pet with you, so I'm sure she was nervous, but thank you for being so kind to her. 

We were able to leave our pet with you without any worries! 
We were also happy to receive updates on her condition via surveillance camera and photos. 

We'll definitely ask you to leave our pet with you again if we need to leave it with you for some other reason. 
Thank you for all your help. 
Thank you very much.

This is a truly trustworthy trainer!

Since the trainer came to our home,

he's become very good at staying home alone,

and he's even learned to sit!

He's only a 4-month-old puppy, so I'm so glad I was able to ask the trainer for help early!

He also taught me how to walk him,

and I'm so grateful he was so flexible with the schedule!

Thank you for your continued support. ☺️

PS. Since you told me it's okay to sleep with my dog, we've been sleeping together every day, and seeing such adorable behavior makes me so happy as an owner. 😂

I live in Tokyo, but my family home is in Kyushu, so I take my dog ​​with me by car when I have long holidays. I often stay overnight in Osaka, and I used your service this time, and I was extremely satisfied.

Even though it was only a short stay, you took my dog ​​for plenty of walks in the evening and morning, and I was able to check on him via camera, which gave me great peace of mind.

Thank you so much for everything. I would definitely like to use your services again in the future!
Thank you for your feedback! ^^

Thank you for taking such good care of my pet.

I'll definitely use your services again next time.
I have a large mixed-breed male dog, and I primarily use their homestay service. …
Thank you for your courteous service. I'll definitely use your services again.
This trainer takes great care of dogs. You can entrust your dog to them with peace of mind.
